clusters.name: us-001-detector-broaden-infra-filter
clusters.executionModeRationale: This cluster's files are fully disjoint from US-002's files. Could run in parallel with US-002 if the bundle-coordination commit is deferred to a synthetic third step; serial ordering chosen because the shared CHANGELOG / AGENTS / version-script files would otherwise create merge conflicts between two parallel branches.

clusters.name: us-002-require-lead-listener-unconditionally-and-bundle-coord
clusters.executionModeRationale: This cluster owns the bundle-coordination commit (CHANGELOG / AGENTS / version-bump script). Serial-after Cluster 1 so the bump-version.js script runs once on the final branch state and the CHANGELOG block reflects BOTH stories' fixes. Shared files (CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, plugin manifests, marketplace indexes, version.test.js) make parallel execution unsafe.
